title: Mixed Event — Bustling Cafe ●REC! — Episode1 An Unexpected Offer

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP!'s latest gig is a TV segment on location at a popular cafe! Little do they realize, it's none other than the cafe where Minori works!

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, so... Our next meeting is Wednesday night, and we have that interview on Saturday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, we have a little bit of a gap...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, hang on. I think they wanted to move this meeting to a different day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was about to schedule us for something else here. I need to not forget about stuff like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's great that we've been receiving so many offers, but this is starting to become too much for just us to handle...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku's even been helping me with this lately, which has made things easier compared to before...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't give enough respect to people who manage idols. How do they do it...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? A message?
Oh, it could be another offer...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: F-For TV...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I couldn't be more grateful that people want us to appear. And it looks like they want us on for one of their segments. I wonder what it's about...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, they want us to report on a cafe!
I think that's a first for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I really wanna do this since I'm pretty good at this sort of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I gotta let the others know...!
bgm_area00002
A few days later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late!
I hope I didn't keep you waiting... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, hello.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait...
Minori isn't here yet?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, she's on classroom duty today, so she'll be running a little late.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She sounded very excited.
I remember her saying, “I'm gonna write the best log entry ever!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like she's trying to get the most out of regular school life before she goes credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I guess we can start discussing our next stream and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Airi and the others are here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haruka told us the good news!
You get to go on TV again, yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're reporting on a cafe, right?
What does that involve exactly?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a segment for a show called “The Late Nite Wednesday Talk Show”, and we get to introduce a cafe in Shibuya that's been getting a lot of buzz.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's hosted by a popular idol and TV personality, and the show itself has been getting pretty good ratings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? Then, this is a huge offer!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The show's producer was apparently looking for some high schoolers who knew Shibuya well, which led them to us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
The producer contacted you directly?
This must've been a big decision.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's proof that everyone in TV is talking about MORE MORE JUMP! now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, that may be a part of it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's actually quite common for staff we have worked with before to refer us as guests for TV gigs.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. As a result, in terms of landing these appearances, who you know ends up being more important than how famous you are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Either way, I'm really happy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So that's how it works.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I have to think the staff referred you girls because of all the hard work you've done up until now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing it air.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
We'll bring over a video after it does!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, this is so exciting♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you know which cafe you'll be going to?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, they said they're still working out the details. We should receive word once everything's finalized.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Everyone!
I have big news! No, huge news!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, hello.
I hope classroom duty went well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's going on? Why do you sound so flustered?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-S-S-So...
That cafe we're supposed to introduce...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They picked the one where I work!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, what are the odds...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But there's a bit of a problem...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A bit of a problem?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah.
During the day of the shoot, they're gonna be short on staff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Short on staff...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A big group made a reservation on the same day as our shoot, which was okay since someone with years of experience had a shift scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But they can't make it now because of a family matter...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One person agreed to fill in, but we're afraid that it's gonna be too much for them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh no. That's terrible...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you can't help because of the shoot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Our hands are tied because I'm not available!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: On top of all that, the manager's been wishing for the longest time that our cafe would get a TV spot. I was so happy at first when I heard the news...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But at this rate, the cafe won't be able to handle a TV shoot, let alone run properly. Which means they might have to turn down this offer...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Well...
I'm sure the manager really wants to do this, so it might be good to tell the show's staff that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Would it be possible for someone to work there just for a day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you know someone who can?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I think I know just the person.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only do they work part-time as front-end staff for retail, they can do quite a lot. Cooking, prepping or waiting tables should be a cinch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But there's no guarantee that they'll agree to help...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Please ask them!
I'll let the manager know what's going on!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Got it.
Then, I'll try asking them.
